name: Maverick Hunter - Dive Armor Axl
desc:
1 Tuner + 1+ "Axl" monsters
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can equip appropriate different "Maverick Boost" Equip Spell Cards from your GY to this card. You can only use this effect of "Maverick Hunter - Dive Armor Axl" once per turn.
Once while face-up on the field (Quick Effect): You can destroy cards on the field up to the number of Equip Spell Cards you control.
strings: Equip Maverick Boost cards from GY
